entities.name: Pari's Golden Beach
entities.description: Beach on an unnamed island littered with golden jetsam, attracting sea dragons.

entities.name: Pari
entities.description: Man who first discovered the beach and reclaimed the Isles of Argive from raiders.

entities.name: Agrippa the Wayfinder
entities.description: Pari's great-grandson who shipwrecked on the island and stole some of the gold.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event after which Pari reclaimed the Isles of Argive.

entities.name: Sea dragons
entities.description: Dragons attracted by the heat above the gold.

events.summary: Pari first discovered the beach after reclaiming the Isles of Argive from raiders.
events.quote: The beach was first discovered by Pari

events.summary: During the Dark Age, Agrippa the Wayfinder shipwrecked on the island, discovered the beach, and stole some gold.
events.quote: before managing to steal off with some of the gold and reach passage with a ship.
